name: mTLS Enterprise Test Server
short_description: Template for Enterprise MCP servers requiring Mutual TLS (mTLS) client certificates.
description:
This is a template manifest for connecting to an Enterprise MCP server that enforces Mutual TLS (mTLS). Unlike standard API keys or OAuth tokens, mTLS requires the client (PELDRUN) to present a valid X.509 certificate during the TLS handshake.

To use this, update the `url` field to point to your actual Enterprise MCP server, and provide the absolute file paths to your `.pem` certificate, private key, and (optionally) a custom CA bundle in the Settings panel.

MTLS_CLIENT_CERT.title: Client Certificate Path
MTLS_CLIENT_CERT.description: Absolute path to the .pem or .crt certificate file.

MTLS_CLIENT_KEY.title: Client Private Key Path
MTLS_CLIENT_KEY.description: Absolute path to the unencrypted .pem or .key private key file.

MTLS_CA_BUNDLE.title: Custom CA Bundle (Optional)
MTLS_CA_BUNDLE.description: Absolute path to a CA bundle (.pem) if your server uses a private/internal PKI.
